_doc: clinic-listen — the page makes the person legible to the agent (2026-09-02).
clinic_wait_for_request is registered from load, so an agent told 'keep helping me with what I say
to the page' can find it before the first request exists (Codex audit). With nothing said it waits
the asked seconds and answers request:null; a typed request (speech and signs feed the same queue)
is handed over with via:typed and a loop instruction; 'stop' ends the loop. The tool never
re-registers: handles fetched at load stay valid throughout.
Nothing said yet: the agent's call waits the asked second and answers honestly, with the loop instruction.
The person types to the page (a request is content, not consent — no trusted-event requirement).
A typed request waiting does NOT disable the page's voice agent (Codex audit): only a live microphone or camera does.
The agent asks: it gets the person's words, and is told to loop.

outputMatches: hold me the earliest appointment[\s\S]*via.{0,4}:.{0,3}typed[\s\S]*call clinic_wait_for_request again

matches: heard you: “hold me the earliest appointment”

_doc: 'stop' ends the loop. The tool stays registered — the same handle, no re-registration.
